statement: For USB Charging Grip 057e:200e, hid-nintendo requires an initial USB handshake 0x80/0x02, optionally attempts 3 Mbaud setup, requires a second handshake and sends no-timeout command without waiting for reply; device-info type distinguishes L/R and SDL has interface-number fallback.

applicability.scope: USB Charging Grip transport, not individual USB Joy-Con PID; no actual grip connected.
